sections.name: Path to Glory
sections.text: Here, you will find additional rules to use with a Kharadron Overlords army while playing through a Path to Glory campaign. The Path to Glory content in this book is divided into two parts: the Anvil of Apotheosis and Paths for Kharadron Overlords units.

sections.name: The Anvil of Apotheosis
sections.text:
You can have 1 Anvil of Apotheosis hero on your Order of Battle and/or army roster, unless otherwise specified in the battlepack you are using. They can be your warlord.
There are 6 steps to follow to create your hero:
1. Set a destiny point limit.
2. Fill out the starting warscroll.
3. Choose an Archetype.
4. Pick your hero’s origin and/or flaw.
5. Pick any Endrinwork Upgrades.
6. Pick any other upgrades.

sections.name: Step 1 - Set a Destiny Point Limit
sections.text:
The Anvil of Apotheosis uses a currency called destiny points. First, you need to set a destiny point limit. This will determine how many destiny points you have to spend on your hero, what type of hero they will be and what their battle profile points cost will be.
Pick 1 of the following:
HERO TYPE | DESTINY POINT LIMIT | BATTLE PROFILE POINTS COST
Bridge Officer | 10 | 150
Aero-Commander | 30 | 250
Skyfleet Magnate | 50 | 350
Over the next few steps, you will pick options for your hero. Each option has a destiny point cost, abbreviated as DP. Keep a record of the number of destiny points you have spent. You cannot exceed the limit you have set.

sections.name: Step 4 - Pick Your Hero's Origin And/Or Flaw
sections.text: You can pick up to 1 origin and up to 1 flaw for your hero. Each adds an ability to your hero’s warscroll. However, instead of costing destiny points, flaws give you extra destiny points to spend elsewhere.

This unit has WARD (4+).
Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly Arkanaut Company unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for a unit within 3" of this unit
-4DP
MASTER OF BALLISTICS
Effect: You can re-roll hit rolls of 1 for the attacks made as part of that SHOOT ability.

sections.text:
You can pick any number of Endrinwork Upgrades for your FLAGSHIP. The same upgrade cannot be picked more than once. When you pick your FLAGSHIP for the battle, for the duration of the battle, it has the Endrinwork Upgrades that you have paid for in addition to its other rules.

sections.name: Path of The Magnate
sections.text:
(KHARADRON OVERLORDS HERO only)
ASPIRING: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
CUSTOM AMMUNITION
Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks.
Passive
DRILLBILL-FEATHER TRIGGER
Effect: This unit’s ranged weapons have Crit (2 Hits).
ELITE: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
LEARNED IN THE WAYS OF THE WIND
Effect: Each time an enemy unit within 9" of this unit uses a MOVE ability, the effects of the’ FLY’ ability do not apply to that unit.
Passive
NULLSTONE AMULET
Effect: This unit can use UNBIND and BANISH abilities as if it had WIZARD (1).
MIGHTY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
CODEBREAKER
Effect: If an enemy unit within 12" of this unit uses the’ Rally’ command, your opponent must make 3 fewer rally rolls of D6.
If a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ’Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.
Any Hero Phase
PHOSPHORIC FLARES
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. If the result is equal to or less than the number of models in the target, pick 1 of the following effects:
For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks made by the target.
For the rest of the turn, re-roll hit rolls of 1 for this unit’s shooting attacks that target that enemy unit.
LEGENDARY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
EMERGENCY BLAST-VENT
Effect: For the rest of the turn, enemy units have STRIKE-LAST while they are in combat with this unit.
Once Per Battle, Any Movement Phase
RESERVE CREW, DISEMBARK!
Declare: Pick a friendly non- HERO non- SKYVESSEL unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
Effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 3" from all enemy units.

sections.name: Path of The Privateer
sections.text:
(non- HERO non- SKYVESSEL KHARADRON OVERLORDS unit only)
ASPIRING: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
SKYFARER'S GRIT
Effect: This unit has WARD (6+) against shooting attacks while it is contesting an objective.
Any Shooting Phase
HAIL OF AETHERSHOT
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, this unit can use SHOOT abilities this turn even if it used a RETREAT ability in the same turn.
ELITE: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
End of Any Turn
STERN AND RESOLUTE
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Subtract D6 from the control score of the target for the rest of the turn.
Passive
CLOUDWALKERS
Effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for this unit.
MIGHTY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
SAPPERS
Declare: Pick an enemy faction terrain feature or MANIFESTATION within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
Passive
DEAL-SEALER ROUNDS
Effect: This unit’s ranged weapons have Crit (Auto-wound).
LEGENDARY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick l of the following abilities for them:
Passive
CHAMONITE-EDGED BLADES
Effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons that have an unmodified Attacks characteristic of 1 or 2.
Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made with this unit’s melee weapons that have an unmodified Attacks characteristic of 3 or more.
Passive
AETHERMATIC AUGMENTS
Effect: Ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.

sections.name: Path of The Skyfleet
sections.text:
(SKYVESSEL KHARADRON OVERLORDS unit only)
ASPIRING: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
RELIABLE ENDRINS
Effect: You can re-roll run rolls and charge rolls for this unit.
Passive
POWERFUL REVERSING PROPELLERS
Effect: This unit can SHOOT abilities even if it used a RETREAT ability in the same turn.
ELITE: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
End of Any Turn
SPIKEHEAD RIVETS
Effect: Inflict 1 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with this unit.
Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
SKYHORN SIREN
Declare: Make a skyhorn blast roll of 4D6. Each enemy unit within X" of this unit is a target, where X is the skyhorn blast roll.
Effect: Roll a dice for each target. Subtract the roll from the target’s control score for the rest of the turn.
MIGHTY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
End of Any Turn
BATTLE-HARDENED ENDRINEERS
Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or less than the current battle round number, Heal (X) this unit, where X is the current battle round number.
Once Per Battle, Reaction: Opponent declared a SHOOT ability
EXHAUST VENTING
Effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack made as part of that SHOOT ability that targets this unit is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.
LEGENDARY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick l of the following abilities for them:
Once Per Battle, Start of Any Battle Round
GATTLESSON'S COLOSSAL DETONATION AMMO
Declare: Pick 1 of this unit’s ranged weapons.
Effect: For the rest of the battle round:
Double the Attacks characteristic of that weapon.
For each unmodified hit roll of 1 for a shooting attack made by this unit, allocate 1 damage point to this unit after the SHOOT ability has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
Passive
NULLSTONE CLOUD-SEEDING
Effect: Spells cast by WIZARDS within 12" of this unit are miscast if any two dice in the unmodified casting roll show the same result.
